**Role: Director of Engineering \- Platform \| eVTOL Aerospace** 




**Location: Dubai \- Tax\-Free** 




**Working Arrangement: Office based**

 Most senior engineering roles are about maintaining something someone else built.
 



  





 This one isn't.
 



  





 We've just come off a briefing with the leadership team of one of the most ambitious aerospace programmes in the world right now, and we need to talk to you. Because if your career has been building towards a moment where you get to stand something up from scratch \- a genuinely novel aircraft, a founding team of world\-class domain engineers, a programme with the kind of commercial backbone that most ventures can only dream about \- this might be it.
 



  





 What is it?
 



 A Director of Engineering \- Platform role on a confidential eVTOL programme based in Dubai South. The aircraft is a next\-generation electric platform designed to deliver life\-saving emergency response capability. Novel configuration. Genuinely unsolved engineering problems. And a mission that, unlike a significant chunk of what the aerospace industry produces, is unambiguously good for the world.
 



  





 The company is both OEM and operator \- they will certify the aircraft and operate a fleet at scale. That combination essentially doesn't exist anywhere else in the industry today. And they're doing it under a 20\-year sovereign customer agreement, which gives this programme the kind of forward visibility that venture\-backed eVTOL companies simply cannot offer.
 



  





 What does the role involve?
 



 You will own engineering operations for the Platform stream. That means building the team, running the technical maturity cadence, managing the gate review rhythm, allocating resources across the domain Chief Engineers, and keeping the programme moving from early architecture through to certification and production. You sit alongside the Chief Engineer \- Platform as an equal counterpart, and you report directly to the CTO.
 



  





 This is not a technical design role. It is a programme execution and people leadership role. The CE decides what gets built. You make sure it gets built.
 



  





 Who are we looking for?
 



 Someone who has led teams of serious engineers \- Chief Engineers or equivalent \- on certified civil aerospace programmes. Someone who has built an engineering organisation in the early stages of a complex programme, not just joined one that was already running. Someone who is comfortable with greenfield ambiguity and thrives in it rather than tolerating it.
 



  





 If you have spent your career in mature OEM programmes with hundreds of engineers and a decades\-old process framework, this will feel different. That's not a warning \- it's a filter. The people who've already joined this programme left very senior roles at very large companies to do it. They did it because the scale of the challenge and the quality of the mission was worth it.
 



  





 The package
 



 Tax\-free in Dubai. Relocation package included. Senior leadership level. Salary details available on application.
 



  





 A note on the location
 



 Dubai South is adjacent to Al Maktoum International Airport \- one of the most significant aviation infrastructure developments in the world. If you have always wanted to be somewhere that takes aerospace seriously, this is it.
 



  





 If this sounds like the kind of opportunity you've been waiting for, apply now or reach out directly. We screen every applicant personally \- no AI filters.
 



  





 We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to treating all applicants with dignity and respect, regardless of background.

**About Jumeirah** 




 Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art\-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.
 



  





**About Jumeirah Burj Al Arab:** 




 Jumeirah Burj Al Arab is more than a hotel, it is a global icon of luxury hospitality. Since opening in 1999, it has defined the pinnacle of the industry, setting new benchmarks in personalised service and creating truly unforgettable guest experiences.
 



 Today, it enters a bold and defining new chapter. After more than 25 years at the forefront of the industry, the property will undergo a carefully considered restoration led by renowned designer Tristan Auer, bringing a refined contemporary vision while preserving the legacy, craftsmanship, and spirit of this extraordinary landmark.
 



  





**About the Job** 




 An exciting opportunity has arisen for a
 **Director of Learning \& Development** 
 to join
 **Jumeirah Burj Al Arab** 
 .

* Lead high\-volume onboarding, re\-induction, and colleague integration with the discipline of a luxury pre\-opening environment, ensuring every colleague is immersed in the Burj Al Arab legacy, service philosophy, brand rituals, and elevated guest experience standards.
* Prepare leaders and colleagues for the next chapter of the property by building the behaviours, confidence, and operational capability required to deliver consistent, intuitive, and highly personalised service at scale.
* Embed a refreshed culture of excellence across all functions, connecting learning to service consistency, colleague engagement, operational readiness, guest experience, and the successful reopening of a landmark luxury property.
* Build a future\-ready talent pipeline through succession planning, career development, and high\-potential programmes that support business continuity, internal mobility, and leadership strength before, during, and beyond the restoration phase.
* Champion innovation across the learning landscape, using modern learning solutions, digital tools, best practices, and measurable insights to enhance capability, colleague experience, service consistency, and overall business performance throughout the hotel’s transformation journey.



  





**About You** 




 The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
 



  




* Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in Learning \& Development, including at least 3–5 years in a leadership role within luxury hospitality.
* Demonstrated success in designing and delivering leadership development, capability\-building, and succession planning initiatives that strengthen organisational performance and prepare future leaders.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience partnering with senior leadership teams to drive organisational change, talent growth, and cultural transformation.
* Passion for developing people and creating exceptional colleague experiences, combined with a forward\-thinking approach to learning innovation, digital learning solutions, and modern development practices.
* Strong commercial and operational awareness, with the ability to align learning priorities to business objectives, service excellence standards, and colleague engagement goals.

**About The American International University**
 American International University (AIU) is a private institution in Kuwait, founded in 2019, offering undergraduate programs in Engineering, Architecture and Design, Business Administration, Arts and Sciences, and Education, delivered in English on the American model of higher education. AIU serves a community of over 3,000 students and is executing the RISE Strategy 2026–2030 a five\-year institutional transformation anchored in research development, WSCUC international accreditation, student success, and community engagement.
   

  

 Teaching and learning excellence is one of the University's principal strategic foundations and an essential enabler of every pillar of the RISE Strategy. Without it, research does not flourish, accreditation evidence is weak, students do not succeed, and employability outcomes disappoint. The Director of the Centre for Teaching \& Learning is the person who builds, sustains, and continuously improves that foundation making this one of the most consequential academic leadership appointments AIU will make.
   

  

 For more information, visit: www.aiu.edu.kw
   

  

 Department Profile
   

  

 The Centre for Teaching \& Learning (CTL) is AIU's institutional hub for teaching excellence, faculty development, and learning innovation. It operates under the Office of the VPAA and serves all five schools and the Foundation Programme working with over 120 full\-time faculty and a growing adjunct complement. The CTL is newly established as one of AIU's strategic academic support centres under the Office of the Vice President for Academic Affairs. The Director serves as its founding leader, responsible for building the Centre's programmes, culture, partnerships, and institutional reputation from the ground up.
   

  

 The CTL carries three interconnected institutional mandates at AIU:
   

  

* Faculty Excellence \& Development: Building a culture of teaching excellence across AIU through structured professional development, peer observation, new faculty induction, individual coaching, and the scholarship of teaching and learning.
* Learning Innovation \& Digital Education: Advancing instructional design, educational technology integration, and evidence\-based pedagogy ensuring that every AIU course, regardless of modality, reflects current best practice and produces documented student learning outcomes.
* Assessment, Accreditation \& Institutional Evidence: Generating, curating, and maintaining the teaching and learning evidence that WSCUC accreditation requires the CTL Knowledge Repository, SLO assessment data, faculty development participation records, and the annual Teaching \& Learning Impact Report.


 Scope of Work
   

  

 The Director of the Centre for Teaching \& Learning provides strategic and operational leadership across five interconnected domains all of which must function simultaneously and reinforce each other. The Director is simultaneously a faculty developer, an instructional designer, an assessment specialist, a grant administrator, and an institutional evidence builder. The Director also serves as an institutional change leader, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, collaboration, and evidence\-informed educational practice across all academic units. This is not a role for a specialist who does one of these well; it is a role for a leader who does all of them, and who can build a centre that extends their capacity through institutional culture and peer networks.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Faculty Professional Development
* Design, deliver, and continuously evaluate a structured, evidence\-based faculty development programme across AIU covering evidence\-based pedagogy, inclusive teaching, active learning, hybrid and online instruction, AI in teaching, student assessment design, and academic writing for publication
* Lead the New Faculty Induction Programme each September a structured, multi\-day orientation covering AIU's mission and RISE Strategy, the SLO assessment cycle, course file requirements, LMS and technology tools, academic freedom, shared governance, and the CTL's services
* Establish and facilitate Faculty Learning Communities peer groups organised around shared teaching interests, disciplinary challenges, or pedagogical themes as the primary vehicle for sustained, collegial professional development
* Coordinate and manage the peer observation of teaching cycle providing the framework, training observers, facilitating feedback conversations, and maintaining confidential records that support faculty development without functioning as a surveillance mechanism
* Provide individual faculty consultations on course design, assessment strategy, student engagement, and teaching effectiveness functioning as a trusted advisor, not an evaluator
* Develop and maintain the CTL professional development calendar, ensuring that sessions are scheduled at times accessible to all faculty including those with heavy teaching loads, offered in formats appropriate to different needs, and evaluated for effectiveness after each cycle
* Coordinate academic leadership development workshops for Programme Coordinators, Department Chairs, Associate Deans and Deans in collaboration with the Office of Faculty Affairs.
* Develop an institutional teaching certification pathway aligned with the UK Professional Standards Framework (Advance HE) or equivalent international framework.
* Instructional Design \& Educational Technology
* Lead instructional design support for AIU's academic programmes assisting Deans, Department Chairs, and individual faculty in designing courses that align learning outcomes with instructional activities and assessment methods, regardless of delivery modality
* Advance AIU's capacity in online and hybrid course design building internal expertise, establishing course quality standards, and ensuring that digital learning experiences are as rigorous and engaging as in\-person instruction
* Coordinate with the CTO and Digital Transformation Office on educational technology adoption evaluating new tools for pedagogical value, training faculty in their use, and ensuring that technology serves learning goals rather than displacing them
* Develop and maintain a practical institutional policy on the use of Generative AI in teaching and learning balancing innovation with academic integrity, and ensuring that faculty understand how to design assessments that remain valid in an AI\-enabled environment
* Build and maintain the CTL Knowledge Repository a curated collection of teaching resources, case studies, grant outputs, peer observation frameworks, and WASC evidence artefacts available to all AIU faculty and retained as institutional evidence
* Work collaboratively with the Office of Graduate Studies in developing high\-quality graduate teaching and supervision practices.

 Education
   

  

 Doctoral degree (PhD or EdD) in Education, Higher Education Pedagogy, Instructional Design, Curriculum and Instruction, Educational Technology, or a closely related discipline required for joint academic appointment eligibility; strongly preferred for the administrative role.

* Demonstrated experience leading or managing a Centre for Teaching \& Learning, or equivalent institutional function, in a GCC university context
* Documented experience designing and delivering faculty professional development programmes including workshops, learning communities, peer observation systems, and online development resources for diverse faculty audiences in a multicultural GCC environment

* Demonstrated experience with SLO/PLO assessment design, rubric development, and close\-the\-loop documentation in an accreditation context WASC, AACSB, or comparable quality framework experience is a significant advantage

* Demonstrated experience supporting institutional strategic planning and organisational change within higher education.
* Experience collaborating with academic quality assurance, accreditation, and institutional effectiveness initiatives.


 Technical and Pedagogical Knowledge
   

  

* Deep, current knowledge of evidence\-based pedagogy active learning, inclusive teaching, culturally responsive instruction, universal design for learning, and the scholarship of teaching and learning (SoTL)
* Proficiency with Canvas (LMS) or equivalent platform both as a course designer and as a platform administrator supporting faculty adoption
* Working knowledge of educational technology tools relevant to GCC higher education including AI tools for teaching and learning, audience response systems, digital assessment platforms, and collaboration tools

* The cultural intelligence to build trust and engagement in a GCC university where teaching culture, professional norms, and attitudes toward feedback vary significantly
* Excellent English oral and written communication the ability to write clearly for different audiences, from a workshop handout to a WSCUC self\-study section to a newsletter article that faculty actually read
* Arabic language proficiency is an advantage particularly for engagement with Arabic\-speaking Kuwaiti faculty and with external stakeholders including PUC
* Strong programme management capability the ability to run multiple concurrent programmes (induction, grants, peer observation, forum, website, repository) without dropping any of them
* Genuine intellectual engagement with teaching the Director of a CTL must be the institution's most enthusiastic advocate for the idea that teaching can always be better, and that better teaching produces better outcomes for students

* Experience in curriculum transformation.
* Experience leading digital transformation.
* Experience establishing institutional communities of practice.


 How to Apply
   

  

 Interested candidates should visit the Job Opportunities section on the AIU website and submit a complete application comprising:
   

  

* A current curriculum vitae
* A cover letter (maximum 3 pages) addressing three specific questions: (1\) Describe a faculty development programme or centre initiative you personally designed and led in a GCC university, what was the starting state, what did you build, and how do you know it worked? (2\) How do you build trust and engagement with faculty who are sceptical about CTL services, what is your strategy for turning opt\-out faculty into advocates? (3\) What is your vision for the AIU Centre for Teaching \& Learning's role in the WASC accreditation process?

 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The selection process includes a structured interview with the VPAA and a teaching and learning strategy presentation to a panel including the VPAA, two Deans, and a Faculty Council representative reflecting the shared governance principles that the CTL Director must embody.
   

  

 Submit applications via: https://aiu.edu.kw/careers/jobs
   

  

 The successful candidate is expected to commence employment at the earliest convenience and no later than September 2026 to be in place for the first New Faculty Induction.
   

  

 AIU is an equal opportunity employer committed to academic excellence, professional integrity, and the digital future of Kuwaiti higher education.

 **Head Coach Épée** 
 is also responsible to organize and deliver the highest level of weekly routine training sessions and specific training camps for the elite and emerging Team Saudi Épée fencers. Together with the High\-Performance Director Fencing and other SOTC\-workforce, his major goal is to develop and oversee a long\-term strategy for the next generation of Saudi elite Épée fencers of both genders. This outstanding coaching role is delivered against the background that fencing was named one of the “podium potential sports” in the Kingdom’s overall Olympic \& Paralympic high\-performance sports strategy towards Brisbane 2032 and the Asian Games in Riyadh 2034\. Therefore, it is clearly aligned with a multi\-year’s perspective with a major focus on building the next generation of Team Saudi Épée fencing athletes.

* Lead the technical and tactical development of national Saudi athletes in Épée (U14, U17, elite levels).
* Lead technical planning for international competitions, training camps and preparation cycles.

data.jd_text:
**About Kotinos** 




 Kotinos is a sports advisory and representation firm based in Doha, working with athletes, institutions, events, and sports\-related products across the region and internationally. We operate across athlete representation, sports marketing, consulting, events, research, and data, with a focus on building commercially successful and strategically positioned sports properties.
 



  





 Kotinos is entering an exciting phase of growth. We are expanding our commercial portfolio, building new sports properties, and creating partnership opportunities for ambitious brands that want to connect with sport, culture, talent, communities, and major moments across Qatar, the GCC/MENA region, and international markets. We are looking for a senior commercial leader who can help shape this next chapter.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Director \- Sponsorship \& Brand Partnerships will lead sponsorship sales and brand partnership development across Kotinos’ athlete portfolio, events, and company\-led sports products.
 



  





 This is a senior revenue\-generating role for a proven commercial closer. The successful candidate will bring a strong personal network of brand, agency, and corporate decision\-makers across Qatar, the wider GCC/MENA region, particularly KSA and UAE, and international markets. The Director will act as Kotinos’ senior commercial lead for sponsorship and brand partnerships. They will work closely with the internal team to refine sponsorship assets, shape compelling commercial propositions, approach the market, lead pitch conversations, negotiate terms, close deals, and help build a structured, repeatable sponsorship sales engine.
 



  





 This is an opportunity for someone who wants to do more than sell existing inventory. The role requires someone who can help build the commercial future of Kotinos: creating new opportunities, developing relationships with leading brands, supporting athletes and events, building the sponsorship function, and contributing to the wider growth of the organization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Commercial Leadership \& Revenue Generation** 



* Lead Kotinos’ sponsorship and brand partnership revenue across athletes, events, and company\-led sports products.
* Personally originate, pitch, negotiate, and close sponsorship and commercial partnership deals.
* Bring and activate an existing, current, and usable network of brand, agency, and corporate decision\-makers from day one.
* Own opportunities from first conversation through to signed agreement, ensuring strong commercial momentum, clear next steps, and proper handover for delivery.
* Lead negotiations with sponsors and partners, ensuring deals are commercially valuable, deliverable, and aligned with the relevant athlete, event, or product.



  





**Partnership Strategy, Packaging \& Market Positioning** 



* Shape how Kotinos’ athletes, events, and sports products are positioned to brands and commercial partners.
* Work with the internal team to refine sponsorship proposals, pitch decks, pricing, rights packages, and commercial narratives.
* Ensure every commercial proposition is clear, sponsor\-focused, and answers the key questions: why this opportunity, why this brand fit, what value is created, what the sponsor receives, what it costs, and what happens next.
* Translate reach, visibility, engagement, audience data, earned media value, and business outcomes into credible sponsor value.
* Use brand feedback, market insights, and performance data to improve future proposals, pricing, packaging, renewals, and upsell opportunities.



  





**Pipeline, Reporting \& Commercial Discipline** 



* Identify and pursue opportunities across sectors including banking, telecom, airlines, luxury, automotive, FMCG, technology, real estate, tourism, media, entertainment, \& etc.
* Build and manage a structured sponsorship pipeline and CRM discipline across Kotinos.
* Ensure each opportunity has a clear stage, owner, next step, value, probability of closure, and follow\-up date.
* Provide leadership with clear visibility on active opportunities, stalled deals, revenue forecasts, commercial priorities, and key blockers.
* Ensure outreach, follow\-ups, reporting, and internal coordination are consistent, professional, and commercially focused.
* Build a more disciplined, scalable, and repeatable approach to sponsorship sales and brand partnerships.



  





**Team Building \& Organizational Growth** 



* Help build and develop Kotinos’ sponsorship function.
* Identify the people, capabilities, tools, and processes required to scale the commercial function over time.
* Support the recruitment, onboarding, and development of future team members within sponsorship sales and partnerships.
* Mentor and guide junior or supporting team members involved in research, proposals, outreach, account management, and partnership delivery.
* Work collaboratively across Kotinos to connect opportunities with the company’s wider ambitions.



  





**Candidate Profile** 



* The ideal candidate is a senior commercial partnerships professional with at least 10 years of experience in sponsorship sales, brand partnerships, commercial rights, media sales, sports business, events, entertainment, or related sectors.
* They are a proven closer, not only a strategist or relationship manager. They are comfortable personally contacting brands, leading pitch meetings, negotiating commercial terms, and being directly accountable for revenue.
* The successful candidate must bring an existing and up\-to\-date contact base of relevant brand, agency, and corporate decision\-makers that can be activated immediately after joining. This is a core requirement of the role.
* They should also have the commercial discipline to professionalize the sponsorship sales process, including pipeline tracking, follow\-up cadence, brand feedback capture, proposal improvement, and commercial reporting.
* We are looking for someone entrepreneurial, ambitious, and hands\-on; someone who is excited by the opportunity to build, sell, lead, and grow with Kotinos.



  





**Required Experience** 



* Minimum 10 years of relevant commercial experience.
* Proven track record of closing sponsorship, partnership, media, event, entertainment, or brand deals.
* Strong existing and active network of senior brand, agency, and corporate decision\-makers across Qatar, GCC/MENA, and international markets.
* Strong understanding of sponsorship sales, brand objectives, rights packaging, commercial storytelling, and partnership ROI.
* Experience building or managing a sponsorship sales pipeline, CRM, or structured commercial reporting process.
* Experience working with athletes, sports properties, events, media platforms, entertainment assets, or brand\-facing partnership environments is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a sales pipeline and report clearly on commercial progress.
* Ability to communicate, pitch, and negotiate fluently in Arabic and English.



  





**Location** 




 The role is based in Doha, Qatar, with expected travel across the GCC/MENA region and potentially internationally for brand, partner, and event meetings.
 



  





**Compensation** 




 The role will include a fixed salary and performance\-based commission linked to closed sponsorship and partnership revenue.

**Description**
**SENIOR MANAGER CAMO – HELICOPTER**
 Senior Manager CAMO is responsible to achieve efficient and effective oversight of the Continuing Airworthiness Management Organization (CAMO), in line to the QCAA Regulatory requirements, as well as ensure/confirm that Part 145 services provided/availed are as per agreed contracts in term of safety, quality and cost. He/she should ensure regulatory requirements are fully complied with all maintenance modification and repair activities are carried out to the highest standard and safety level, in the most productive and cost\-effective manner, maximizing resources to achieve an acceptable level of aircraft safety, availability, and reliability to ensure aircraft high level of safety to meet customer regulatory expectations.
   

  

**Main Duties**
* Develop, implement and maintain an Aircraft Maintenance Programme in line along with an efficient reliability program capable to ensure high reliability and availability of the Helicopter fleet.
* Participate in the development of the long\-term strategy by proactively planning all the required resources to cope with Helicopter fleet growth plans, mitigate risks linked to functional scope of responsibility.
* Develop and implement all required procedures to ensure the sustainable compliance to regulations.
* Develop and deliver policies and procedures that ensure operational requirements are consistently met, cost effectively, safely delivered and comply with all applicable business and industry specific legislative/regulatory requirements.
* Develop Helicopter CAMO into an effective organization to manage and maintain the continuing airworthiness of fleet in accordance with approved requirements.
* Determine appropriate strategies to optimize manpower, resources and systems to improve efficiency and minimize costs.
* Identify and implement industry best practices to enhance operational effectiveness and organizational performance.
* Support the development and growth of helicopter operations in alignment with – Helicopter strategic objectives.


 Qualification
   

  

**Qualification, Experience \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Aircraft Maintenance Engineering, or other relevant aviation discipline.
* Professional qualifications and aircraft maintenance licences are desirable.
* Minimum 10 years relevant experience.
* Executive Management job\-related experience required.
* Experience managing helicopter continuing airworthiness activities is highly desirable.
* Experience in performing engineering and/or maintenance planning activities, preferably in a corporate, regional or charter aircraft environment.
* Experience within a QCAA and/or EASA regulatory environment.
* Demonstrated project management and leadership experience.
